pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Question: Will the pedestrian located at [1598, 978, 1657, 1152] in frame 1 cross the road? Justify your answer with spatial, temporal, mathematical, ego-vehicle, and scene-context reasoning. Conclude the pedestrian’s motives.

pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Temporal_Reason: Throughout all 10 frames, the pedestrian transitions from standing to walking but maintains the action of 'walking along the side of the road' without any preparatory movements or gaze shifts toward potential crossing points.

pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Conclusion: The pedestrian will not cross the road because they are walking steadily along the sidewalk parallel to traffic, showing no signs of turning toward the road or preparing to cross, while the environment lacks crossing infrastructure.
